_comment: GitHub identities of Basita's agents (BASITA-149, BASITA-157). No secrets: the private keys and tokens are in the macOS Keychain, account 'basita', under the names in 'keychain'. An App whose app_id is null is pending: Ahmed creates it with scripts/gh-app-new (setup S2), and until then agent-gh and agent-git refuse it. See standards/06-agent-identity.md.
_protected_prefixes: basita-ops sync.sh merges claude/* branches into main by itself, so an App must not push one
_branch_prefix: an App with a branch_prefix pushes only to branches that start with it (BASITA-157)
